title: Wildfly: Apache MINA SSHD is a Java library for client-side and server-side SSH (CVE-2026-93994)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-93994) affects the Wildfly package due to an issue in Apache MINA SSHD, a Java library used for SSH client and server functionality. Versions of Wildfly prior to 42.0.0-r1 are affected. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.1, indicating a network exploitable flaw with low attack complexity and requiring low privileges, resulting in high confidentiality and integrity impact but no availability impact. A patch is available in Wildfly version 42.0.0-r1.
